data.evidence: Both real images name this vnodeop_desc vnop_getnamedstream through their chained pointer at +8. Scalar flags, five argument offsets, terminated vnode-argument-offset array and null transports match. vdesc_offset is a 32-bit first field at +0 on both sides; vfs_op_init assigns the native canonical object its runtime operation index. This binds the pointer identity rather than copying or zeroing a descriptor. Detailed ABI and runtime evidence: apfs-vnop-descriptor-bindings-20261031.json.
